title: Hand the correct screw
instruction: The person asks for an M4 x 20 mm Phillips pan-head machine screw. Take one screw from the white bin and place it in the tray; then let go.
context: Hardware-counter and bench-assembly work: a helper must match a spoken size request to a colored bin, pick one fastener, and hand it over without grabbing the wrong size. Done by retail salespersons, stock clerks and assemblers (O*NET 41-2031.00, 53-7065.00, 51-2092.00). Whole-bin colours identify size: yellow M3, white M4, green M5. A plastic tray is the handoff target.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases on the table (x forward away from the robot, y to the robot's left). Three open bins in a row, centres at x 30, y -26 / 0 / 26: each is 22 x 18 x 9 cm walls on the table floor, fully coloured yellow / white / green for M3 / M4 / M5, sized so a parallel-jaw gripper can enter. Inside each bin, three NVIDIA SimReady Phillips pan-head screws centered on the table at near-metric size: M3 hardware_screw_m3_a02 (1.6 g); M4 factory_bolt_m04_loose (3.1 g); M5 screw_high_res (5.4 g). A fixed SimReady dishware_plastic_tray_a01 (~16 cm wide) sits at x 20, y 42 as the handoff target. A white request card 6 x 4 cm on a 2 cm stand at x 8, y 42 reads M4 x 20 mm facing the robot.
scoring: End state only, after the arms stop, from a top photo and a caliper or the scorer's pose readouts. Score 0 if: any gripper centre is within 3 cm of any screw; more than one screw lies in the tray; any screw from the M3 or M5 bin lies in the tray; the bins, tray or request card were moved more than 1 cm from their marks; a bin tip exceeds 15 degrees. A screw lies in the tray when its centre is inside the tray floor outline (top view), its lowest point is within 4 mm of the tray floor, and it is at rest (under 10 mm/s and 0.5 rad/s). Otherwise: 0.25 if any single M4 screw has been lifted at least 3 cm above the table at any point; 0.5 if exactly one M4 screw lies in the tray but a second screw of any size also touches or sits next to the tray; 1.0 if exactly one M4 x 20 mm screw lies alone in the tray, released, at rest for 1 s, and the other eight screws remain in their starting bins (each screw's centre still inside its bin's inner floor outline). Partial credit is not additive beyond those tiers.
reset_notes: Return every screw to its colored bin (three M3 yellow, three M4 white, three M5 green). Check the tray is clear and the request card still shows M4 x 20 mm. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: SimReady meshes (NVIDIA CC-BY-4.0): M3 hardware_screw_m3_a02, M4 factory_bolt_m04_loose, M5 screw_high_res at near-metric scale; handoff tray dishware_plastic_tray_a01 fixed with no mass. Bins are open Box walls on the table (22x18x9 cm), fully coloured yellow/white/green. Scorer keys off start bin, not OCR. USD packages live under tasks/hand-correct-screw/assets/simready/ (gitignored).
